ali: Quick idea 1 Start small webinar + drip for a PLG funnel test: offer 750 tokens to registrants, +250 bonus for attendees. Short demo (15m) + 2 follow-up posts with prompt templates. KPI: uplift in first-API-call rate by 12%.

marisol: love it. timing? we should avoid overlap with next week's partner webinar.

ali: propose Wed 11am PT next week. creative + landing by Tue EOD. growth run paid + organic.

jake: ok on paid. quick ops Q: are credits auto-claimed on attendance or require click? which reduces fraud?

sophie: suggest claim button in post-webinar modal. registrants get 750 on signup; attendees see a "Claim 250" CTA in the thank-you modal. that keeps UX simple.

tariq: also add a one-click "Run starter prompt" in the claim modal so users immediately consume tokens. reduces churn.

marisol: copy options for email subject test: A) "Get 1,000 tokens to try Redwood Inference" B) "Free tokens + starter prompts for builders". we'll A/B test.

ali: growth to split 40/60 on subject variants (more traffic on A). jake, add cohort param: `cohort=webinar_sprint_0412_A|B`.

jake: will do. landing snippet for devs: `?utm_source={{channel}}&utm_campaign=webinar_sprint_0412&cohort={{cohort}}`. PR to marketing infra due Mon.

growth-bot: Paid channels recommended: Twitter devs, GitHub sponsors ads, Reddit r/MachineLearning small buy. Budget estimate: $3k.

marisol: creative brief to design: 1 hero banner, 3 social post variants, 2 email templates, and a tiny prompt pack (3 prompts). Tone: pragmatic, code-first.

analytics-bot: New event added: `webinar_credit_claimed` with props ["utm_campaign","cohort","variant","attended"].

ali: measurement: funnel checkpoints we need: registrant, attendee, credit_claimed, first_api_call. owner: marisol + analytics.

jake: note on privacy: callout on landing that credits apply to hosted API only; private customers contact sales. Will add a short line under CTA.

sophie: logistics owned. I'll book Zoom, enable registration, record, and upload to content bucket. Speaker will demo embed search + quick prompt pack. Keep demo <=15m.

marisol: A/B landing hero test: "1,000 tokens for builders" vs "Starter prompts + credits". small hermes test.

ali: action list: marisol = copy + variants, jake = landing + tracking, sophie = logistics + recording, tariq = prompt pack + claim modal UX, growth-bot = channels + budget. We'll sync Tues for design review. :eyes:

marisol: can analytics expose UTM attribution for claimed credits so we know which ad drove activation?

analytics-bot: `webinar_credit_claimed` includes utm props; dashboard tile will be ready Wed AM (preview).

jake: PR link to WIP landing: https://git.internal/redwood/marketing/webinar-sprint-0412 (WIP).

ali: nice. keep the post-webinar drip: 1) quick highlight post with recording + prompt pack, 2) follow-up email 48h with "Try this with your credits" CTA.

sophie: noted. will prepare calendar + CTAs.

ali: thanks team. Friday go/no-go sync on calendar. :rocket:
